about_the_game:
PHOTOSENSITIVITY WARNING: THIS GAME CONTAINS STROBING LIGHTS AND HARSH FLASHES. 

DISTURBING CONTENT: THIS GAME FEATURES DISTURBING CONTENT AND IS NOT SUITABLE FOR CHILDREN.

The old, unfinished Lily's Lil Games webseries is back, and recompiled for modern systems!

Welcome to the Happy Video Store, where every day is a brand-new adventure! Step into the shoes of Lily, a bright and cheerful employee determined to become the very best worker her little hometown rental shop has ever seen.

Your job sounds simple enough:

  • 📼 Sort through endless VHS tapes and keep the rows looking perfect.

  • 🛒 Stock shelves and clean up after customers, no matter how messy they get.

  • 👭 Spend time with Mimi, Lily’s best friend who sometimes stops by during shifts.

Every shift gives you new challenges, new visitors, and new chances to help Lily prove she’s the best employee.

Clock in. Do your best. Keep the shelves tidy.
At the Happy Video Store, the fun never ends.

content_descriptors.notes: Disturbing images and sequences of death.
